senses.meaning_zh: 耳屏：外耳道口前方的小块软骨突起，通常指两侧或多个耳屏
senses.meaning_en: The small cartilaginous projections immediately in front of the ear-canal openings.
senses.english_definition: Your tragi are the small pieces of cartilage covered with skin that project in front of the openings of your ear canals.
senses.collocation_en: prominent tragi; tenderness of the tragi
senses.collocation_zh: 突出的耳屏；耳屏触痛

etymology_story.zh: tragi 是新拉丁语解剖名词 tragus 的复数；tragus 来自希腊语 tragos“公山羊”。耳部这一名称通常被解释为与耳屏处生长的毛发像山羊胡须有关。
etymology_story.en: Tragi is the plural of the New Latin anatomical noun tragus, from Greek tragos, meaning a male goat. The anatomical name is generally explained as referring to hair on the tragus resembling a goat's beard.

morphology_enriched.zh: tragus → tragi：将拉丁式单数词尾 -us 替换为复数词尾 -i，不是在完整的 tragus 后直接加 -i。核心词族包括 tragus“耳屏”、tragi“多个耳屏”和 tragal“耳屏的”；相关解剖词还有 antitragus“对耳屏”、antitragi“多个对耳屏”和 antitragal“对耳屏的”。
morphology_enriched.en: Tragus becomes tragi by replacing the Latin singular ending -us with the plural ending -i, rather than adding -i to the complete word tragus. The core family comprises tragus, tragi, and tragal; related anatomical terms include antitragus, antitragi, and antitragal.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: tragi 没有常用的严格同义词。tragal projections“耳屏突起”可作解释性近义表达；tragus 是其单数；antitragi“对耳屏”指相对位置的另一组结构，不能替换 tragi。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Tragi has no common exact synonym. Tragal projections is an explanatory near-equivalent; tragus is the singular form; antitragi denotes the opposing anatomical projections and cannot replace tragi.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 一侧是 tragus，两侧是 tragi；耳屏上的毛发联想到“小山羊胡须”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: One tragus, two tragi; connect the historical goat image with a small tuft of hair.

senses.collocation_en: a volvox colony; volvox daughter colonies

etymology_story.zh: 英语词 volvox 来自新拉丁语属名 Volvox，最终源于拉丁语 volvere，意为“滚动、转动”。这个名称呼应了团藻球形群体在水中旋转游动的样子。
etymology_story.en: English volvox comes from the New Latin genus name Volvox, ultimately from Latin volvere, meaning 'to roll or turn.' The name evokes the rotating movement of its spherical colonies through water.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，volvox 是完整借入的名词，不宜拆成能自由组合的英语词根和词缀；正式属名写作 Volvox。相关学术词有 volvocine（团藻类的）和 Volvocaceae（团藻科），使用派生词干 volvoc-；这些词属于分类学词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, volvox is a borrowed noun rather than a freely productive combination of English roots and affixes; the formal genus name is Volvox. Related scientific forms include volvocine and Volvocaceae, the family name, which use the combining stem volvoc- and belong to its taxonomic word family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 没有常用的严格同义词。colonial green alga（群体绿藻）描述其组织形式，green alga（绿藻）是更宽泛的类别，volvocine alga（团藻类绿藻）也可包括团藻属以外的相关藻类。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no common exact synonym. Colonial green alga describes its organization, green alga names a broader category, and volvocine alga can also include related algae outside the genus Volvox.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“滚动”：团藻像一个在水中转动的绿色小球。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor it to 'rolling': volvox looks like a little green ball turning through water.

senses.english_definition: Something that is Aymara belongs or relates to the Aymara people, their language, or their culture.

etymology_story.zh: 英语 Aymara 经由西班牙语 aymara 借入，其来源是南美洲的本土族群名称。这个名称也用于该族群的语言，并可作形容词表示相关的人、语言和文化。
etymology_story.en: English Aymara was borrowed through Spanish aymara from an Indigenous South American ethnic name. The name also came to designate the people's language and functions as an adjective for their people, language, and culture.

morphology_enriched.zh: Aymara 是不可再按现代英语词缀分析的名称，同形用于名词和形容词。人的复数可用 Aymara 或 Aymaras；相关形式 Aymaran 可作形容词，也用于语言分类，但具体范围取决于语境。
morphology_enriched.en: Aymara is a name without a productive internal English affix structure, and the same form serves as a noun and adjective. The plural for people can be Aymara or Aymaras; the related form Aymaran functions as an adjective and in linguistic classification, with its scope depending on context.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Aymaran（艾马拉的）是相关替代形式，但在语言学中可能涉及更广的分类；Aymara people（艾马拉人）明确指族群，Aymara language（艾马拉语）明确指语言，两者不是可以任意互换的同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Aymaran is a related alternative but can have a broader classificatory use in linguistics. Aymara people explicitly identifies the ethnic group, while Aymara language explicitly identifies the language; these expressions are not freely interchangeable synonyms.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把一个名称连到三个对象：安第斯的艾马拉人、他们的语言和文化。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect one name to three things: an Andean people, their language, and their culture.

etymology_story.zh: Ceres 原是罗马农业与谷物女神的拉丁语名字。1801年发现的天体以这位女神命名，中文“谷神星”保留了这一神话联系。
etymology_story.en: Ceres was originally the Latin name of the Roman goddess of agriculture and grain. The celestial body discovered in 1801 was named after her, a connection also preserved in its Chinese name, meaning 'grain-goddess star.'

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中的 Ceres 是完整专名，不作普通的词根加词缀拆分。相关派生词包括 Cerean（谷神星的）；历史词族还包括 cereal（谷物；谷物的，经拉丁语中间形式而来）和 cerium（铈，以谷神星命名），不能简单视为直接给 Ceres 添加现代英语词缀。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Ceres is an intact proper name rather than an ordinary root-plus-affix formation. Related derivatives include Cerean, meaning 'of Ceres'; its historical word family also includes cereal, through intermediate Latin forms, and cerium, named after the celestial body, rather than formed by simply adding productive English suffixes to Ceres.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 天文学中，1 Ceres（编号为1的谷神星）是同一天体的编号名称，dwarf planet（矮行星）只是其类别。神话中，Demeter（得墨忒耳）是与刻瑞斯相对应的希腊女神，两者属于不同的神话传统。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: In astronomy, 1 Ceres is the numbered designation of the same body, while dwarf planet names its category. In mythology, Demeter is Ceres's Greek counterpart, but the two belong to different mythological traditions.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 谷物女神上了天空：Ceres 既是谷神，也是谷神星。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture the grain goddess in the sky: Ceres names both the goddess and the dwarf planet.

etymology.text: 来自拉丁语 cetus，意为“海怪、大型海兽”。星座的形象像巨大的海兽，中文习称鲸鱼座。

senses.meaning_zh: 鲸鱼座
senses.meaning_en: A constellation traditionally represented as a whale or sea monster.
senses.english_definition: Cetus is a large constellation near the celestial equator that is traditionally pictured as a whale or sea monster.
senses.collocation_en: the constellation Cetus; a star in Cetus
senses.collocation_zh: 鲸鱼座；鲸鱼座中的一颗恒星
senses.sentence_en: Mira is a variable star in Cetus.
senses.sentence_zh: 米拉星是鲸鱼座中的一颗变星。

etymology_story.zh: Cetus 来自拉丁语 cetus，意为“海怪、大型海兽”，后者借自希腊语 kētos。这个古老星座与希腊神话中的海怪形象有关，中文通常称为“鲸鱼座”。
etymology_story.en: Cetus comes from Latin cetus, meaning 'sea monster or large sea animal,' borrowed from Greek kētos. The ancient constellation is associated with a sea monster in Greek mythology and is conventionally called the Whale in English.

morphology_enriched.zh: Cetus 在现代英语中是完整星座名，没有可自由拆分的英语词缀。其拉丁语属格为 Ceti，用于恒星名称，如 Tau Ceti（鲸鱼座τ星）；缩写为 Cet。cetacean（鲸类动物；鲸类的）和 Cetacea（鲸目）与其共享历史词源，但不是由星座名直接派生的现代英语形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Cetus is an intact constellation name without a productive internal English affix structure. Its Latin genitive is Ceti, used in star names such as Tau Ceti, and its abbreviation is Cet. Cetacean and Cetacea share its historical source but are not modern English derivatives formed directly from the constellation name.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: the Whale（鲸鱼）和 the Sea Monster（海怪）是这个星座的传统描述性名称；Cetus 才是正式拉丁名称。普通名词 whale 指真实的鲸，不能在所有语境中替换 Cetus。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The Whale and the Sea Monster are traditional descriptive names for the constellation; Cetus is its formal Latin name. The ordinary noun whale denotes an actual animal and cannot replace Cetus in every context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把古代“海怪”投向星空，就是鲸鱼座 Cetus。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Project an ancient sea monster onto the stars: that is Cetus.

etymology_story.zh: dees 是 dee 的规则复数；dee 是把字母 D 的名称按读音拼写出来的词。复数词尾 -s 在元音后读作 /z/，因此 dees 读作 /diːz/。
etymology_story.en: Dees is the regular plural of dee, a spelling of the spoken name of the letter D. The plural ending -s is pronounced /z/ after the vowel, giving /diːz/.

morphology_enriched.zh: dee（字母D的名称）+ -s（复数词尾）→ dees。dee 和 dees 构成这里的单复数关系，没有常用的进一步派生词族；Ds 是直接用字母书写的对应复数形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Dee, the name of the letter D, + plural -s → dees. Dee and dees form the singular–plural pair here, with no common further derivational family; Ds is the corresponding plural written with the letter itself.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Ds（多个D）是更直接的字母写法，the letter D（字母D）通常指该字母本身，D sounds（D音）则指语音，不能等同于字母名称的复数 dees。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Ds is the more direct letter-based spelling. The letter D usually refers to the letter as a category, while D sounds refers to speech sounds rather than multiple instances of its written name, dees.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: D 读 dee，多个 dee 加 -s，就是 dees。
mnemonic_anchor.en: D is called dee; more than one dee gives dees.

etymology_story.zh: 英语经拉丁语 dithyrambus 借自古希腊语 dithyrambos，原指敬奉狄俄尼索斯的合唱颂歌；希腊词更早的来源尚不确定。由于这种颂歌情感强烈、风格奔放，词义后来扩展为狂热的诗文或赞颂。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed the word through Latin dithyrambus from Greek dithyrambos, a choral hymn to Dionysus; the Greek word's earlier origin is uncertain. The hymn's passionate character later gave rise to the meaning of an exuberant composition or extravagant expression of praise.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 dithyramb 是整体借入的词基，不宜强拆为普通前后缀。词族：dithyrambs（复数）、dithyrambic（酒神颂歌式的；狂热赞颂的）、dithyrambically（狂热赞颂地）、dithyrambist（酒神颂歌作者，罕用）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, dithyramb is a borrowed base rather than a transparent combination of ordinary affixes. Its family includes dithyrambs, dithyrambic, dithyrambically, and the rare dithyrambist, meaning a composer of dithyrambs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: hymn（赞美诗）侧重对神明的赞颂；paean（赞歌）侧重喜悦、胜利或热烈赞美；panegyric（颂辞）侧重正式而铺陈的赞扬。dithyramb 具有特定的酒神祭祀背景，引申义尤其突出情绪奔放。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: A hymn typically praises a deity; a paean expresses joy, triumph, or enthusiastic praise; a panegyric offers formal, elaborate praise. Dithyramb has a specific Dionysian background and, figuratively, particularly emphasizes emotional exuberance.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 酒神祭上的奔放合唱 → 情绪奔放的赞颂。
mnemonic_anchor.en: An exuberant chorus for the wine god → an exuberant outpouring of praise.

meaning: 单旋律声部乐曲；独唱曲

pronunciation.note: 按所列读音编写；音标采用 IPA。

family: monodic 单旋律的；monodist 单旋律乐曲作者

morphology.text: mono-（单一）+ -ody（歌唱）→ monody（单一旋律的歌或乐曲）。

senses.meaning_zh: 单旋律音乐；尤指以伴奏衬托单一独唱声部的音乐
senses.meaning_en: Music with a single melodic line, especially solo singing with accompaniment.
senses.english_definition: Monody is music built around one melodic line, especially a solo vocal line supported by instrumental accompaniment.
senses.collocation_zh: 有伴奏的单声歌曲；巴洛克早期的单声歌曲
senses.sentence_en: Early Baroque monody placed the solo voice above a simple instrumental accompaniment.
senses.sentence_zh: 巴洛克早期的单声歌曲以独唱声部为主体，配以简单的器乐伴奏。

senses.meaning_zh: 独唱哀歌；以单一说话者口吻写成的悼诗
senses.meaning_en: A lament sung by one person or a poem of mourning spoken in a single voice.
senses.english_definition: A monody is a song or poem in which one person expresses grief, especially over someone's death.
senses.collocation_en: a monody on the death of someone; a funeral monody
senses.collocation_zh: 悼念某人去世的哀诗；葬礼独唱哀歌
senses.sentence_en: The poet wrote a monody on the death of his closest friend.
senses.sentence_zh: 诗人为挚友的去世写了一首悼诗。

etymology_story.zh: 英语经后期拉丁语 monodia 来自希腊语 monōidia，由 monos（单独的）和与 ōidē（歌）相关的成分组成，原指独唱。在文学中发展为单人抒发哀思的诗歌，在音乐中则用于单一旋律声部的写法，尤其是巴洛克早期有伴奏的独唱。
etymology_story.en: English received the word through Late Latin monodia from Greek monōidia, combining monos, meaning alone, with an element related to ōidē, meaning song. It developed literary uses for a single voice expressing grief and musical uses for a single melodic line, especially accompanied solo singing in the early Baroque period.

morphology_enriched.zh: 可按学术构词成分理解为 mon(o)-（单一）+ -ody（歌），但在现代英语中也是整体使用的借词。词族：monodies（复数）、monodic／monodical（单旋律的；独唱的）、monodically（以单旋律方式）、monodist（单声歌曲或独唱哀歌作者，罕用）。
morphology_enriched.en: The learned formation can be understood as mon(o)-, meaning single, plus -ody, meaning song, although monody also functions as an established borrowed word. Its family includes monodies, monodic, monodical, monodically, and the rare monodist, a composer or writer of monodies.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: monophony（单声织体）通常指没有和声伴奏的单一旋律；monody 尤其可指有伴奏的独唱旋律。elegy（挽诗）强调悼亡或沉思，lament（哀歌；哀诉）泛指悲伤的表达，二者都不要求采用单一声音。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Monophony normally means a single melodic line without harmonic accompaniment, whereas monody can specifically describe accompanied solo singing. An elegy emphasizes mourning or reflection, and a lament is any expression of grief; neither necessarily requires a single voice.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: mono-＝一个，-ody＝歌：一个声音唱出旋律，也唱出哀思。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Mono- means one and -ody means song: one voice carries the melody or the mourning.

morphology.text: thé（法语“茶”）+ -ine（物质名称后缀）→ théine → theine / thein；英语拼写作为完整词记忆。

etymology.text: 英语 theine 来自法语 théine，法语 thé 表示“茶”；thein 是英语的另一种拼写。词名保留了它与茶的联系。

senses.english_definition: Thein is an old name for the caffeine in tea, which is the same chemical substance as the caffeine in coffee.
senses.collocation_en: thein in tea; the isolation of thein

senses.sentence_zh: 那本旧化学书用 thein 这个名称指从茶中提取的咖啡因。

etymology_story.zh: thein 是 theine 的异体拼写，后者来自法语 théine，由 thé（茶）加化学物质名称后缀 -ine 构成。这个名称源于从茶中分离该物质的历史，后来确认它与咖啡因是同一种化合物。
etymology_story.en: Thein is a variant of theine, borrowed from French théine, formed from thé, meaning tea, and the chemical suffix -ine. The name reflects the substance's isolation from tea; it was later established to be chemically identical to caffeine.

morphology_enriched.zh: 历史构词为法语 thé（茶）+ -ine（物质名称后缀）→ théine → 英语 theine／thein；现代英语中按整体化学旧名识记。theine 是拼写变体；caffeine（咖啡因）是现代同义名称，并非由 thein 派生；没有常用的现代派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Historically, French thé, meaning tea, plus the substance suffix -ine produced théine, borrowed as theine or thein. Modern English treats it as a whole historical chemical name: theine is a spelling variant, caffeine is the modern equivalent rather than a derivative, and there is no common productive derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: theine 是同一旧称的另一拼写；caffeine（咖啡因）是现代通用名称，不限于茶中的来源。theophylline（茶碱）虽然名称相近，却是另一种化合物，不能作为同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Theine is another spelling of the same historical name; caffeine is the standard modern name regardless of its source. Theophylline, despite its tea-related name, is a different compound and is not a synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 法语 thé＝茶：thein 是“从茶得名的咖啡因”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: French thé means tea: thein is caffeine named after its tea source.

pronunciation.note: 采用 Cambridge 所列英式读法，省略音节分隔点。

senses.meaning_zh: 南方古猿属；一属已灭绝的非洲早期人族成员
senses.meaning_en: A genus of extinct early African hominins.
senses.english_definition: Australopithecus is a genus of extinct human relatives that lived in Africa and walked upright while retaining several ape-like features.
senses.collocation_zh: 阿法南方古猿；南方古猿属化石
senses.sentence_en: Lucy is a famous fossil of Australopithecus afarensis.
senses.sentence_zh: “露西”是一具著名的阿法南方古猿化石。

etymology_story.zh: 这一新拉丁语属名由拉丁语 australis（南方的）和源自希腊语 pithēkos（猿）的成分组成，字面意思是“南方的猿”。雷蒙德·达特于1925年命名 Australopithecus africanus，名称中的“南方”与南非发现的化石有关，而非指澳大利亚。
etymology_story.en: This New Latin genus name combines Latin australis, meaning southern, with an element from Greek pithēkos, meaning ape, giving the literal meaning southern ape. Raymond Dart named Australopithecus africanus in 1925, with southern referring to the South African fossil discovery rather than Australia.

morphology_enriched.zh: 学术构词：austral-（南方的）+ -o-（连接元音）+ -pithecus（猿）→ Australopithecus。相关词形有 australopithecine（南方古猿类成员；南方古猿类的）及其复数 australopithecines，以及缩略形式 australopith（南方古猿类成员）；这些普通名词的范围可比严格的属名更宽。
morphology_enriched.en: The learned formation is austral-, meaning southern, plus the linking vowel -o- and -pithecus, meaning ape. Related forms include australopithecine, used as a noun and adjective, its plural australopithecines, and the shortened noun australopith; these common terms can have a broader scope than the strict genus name.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: australopith（南方古猿类成员）是相关普通名称；australopithecine（南方古猿类成员）在某些用法中还包括其他近缘属；hominin（人族成员）范围更广，包括现代人及其已灭绝的近亲。它们都不是在所有分类语境下可直接替换的严格同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Australopith is a related common term; australopithecine can include members of other closely related genera in some usages; hominin is broader and includes modern humans and their extinct close relatives. None is an exact substitute for the genus name in every taxonomic context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: austral＝南方，pithecus＝猿：南方发现的“南方古猿”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Austral means southern and pithecus means ape: the southern ape named from a southern African discovery.

senses.sentence_en: Odysseus had to steer his ship past Scylla and Charybdis.
senses.sentence_zh: 奥德修斯必须驾船驶过斯库拉与卡律布狄斯所在的险境。

senses.meaning_zh: 两难处境中的一重险境；常见于 between Scylla and Charybdis
senses.meaning_en: One of two opposing dangers in a difficult choice, especially in the expression between Scylla and Charybdis.
senses.english_definition: If someone is between Scylla and Charybdis, they face two dangers, and avoiding one may bring them closer to the other.
senses.collocation_en: between Scylla and Charybdis; steer between Scylla and Charybdis
senses.collocation_zh: 进退维谷；在两重险境之间设法周旋
senses.sentence_en: With higher prices threatening sales and lower prices threatening profits, the company was caught between Scylla and Charybdis.
senses.sentence_zh: 提价会影响销量，降价又会损害利润，公司因此陷入了进退维谷的境地。

etymology_story.zh: 英语经拉丁语沿用古希腊语名字 Kharybdis，其更早的词源并不确定。古代故事把吞噬船只的漩涡化为海怪，并将其与附近的斯库拉并置，由此产生了表示腹背受险的典故。
etymology_story.en: English adopted the Greek name Kharybdis through Latin; its deeper origin is uncertain. Ancient stories personified a ship-devouring whirlpool as a monster and paired it with nearby Scylla, producing an enduring allusion to danger on either side.

morphology_enriched.zh: Charybdis 是整体借入的专名，现代英语中不宜拆成有独立意义的普通词缀。罕见派生形容词 Charybdian 使用 Charybd- 词干加 -ian，意为“卡律布狄斯的；如其漩涡般危险的”；没有常用的现代派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Charybdis is a borrowed proper name and has no transparent breakdown into ordinary modern English affixes. The rare adjective Charybdian uses the stem Charybd- plus -ian and means relating to Charybdis or resembling its dangerous whirlpool; there is no common productive derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: whirlpool（漩涡）是对相关水流现象的普通描述；maelstrom（大漩涡）强调规模和威力；dilemma（两难处境）可概括整个 between Scylla and Charybdis 所表达的困境。这些是相关释义词，并非该神话专名的严格同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Whirlpool describes the associated water phenomenon in ordinary language; maelstrom suggests a particularly powerful whirlpool; dilemma can summarize the predicament expressed by between Scylla and Charybdis. These are explanatory equivalents rather than exact synonyms of the mythological name.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 一边是斯库拉，一边是卡律布狄斯的漩涡：往哪边都危险。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Scylla on one side, Charybdis's whirlpool on the other: either direction brings danger.

pronunciation.note: 美式读音。依据 Merriam-Webster 重拼标音转写 IPA。

morphology.text: holo-（全部） + -cene（近代的） → Holocene（全新世的）；把它记作地质时代系列中“全然近代”的名称。

etymology.text: 英语借自法语 holocène，由表示“全部”的 holo- 与表示“近代”的 -cène 组成。名称像给地球最近一段历史贴上“全新”的标签。

usage_note: 地质时代名称首字母大写；本课教形容词用法，放在 sediment、deposit 等名词前。它指特定地质时代，不能泛指任何新近事物。

etymology_story.zh: 英语借自法语 holocène，由源于希腊语的 holo-“全部”和 -cène“新的、近代的”组成。这个名称字面意为“全然近代的”，用来命名更新世之后的地质世。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed French holocène, formed from Greek elements meaning 'whole' and 'new or recent.' Literally 'wholly recent,' the name was applied to the geological epoch following the Pleistocene.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构形：holo-（全部）+ -cene（新的、近代的；地质世名称构形成分）→ Holocene。现代英语中可作名词和形容词；没有常用的进一步派生形式。Pleistocene、Pliocene 等共享 -cene，但属于平行构词，并非 Holocene 的派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: holo- ('whole') + -cene ('new or recent,' used in geological epoch names) → Holocene. It functions as both a noun and an adjective, with no common further derivatives. Pleistocene and Pliocene share -cene but are parallel formations, not derivatives of Holocene.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 近义或相关表达：Recent 是全新世的传统名称；postglacial“冰期后的”强调冰川消退后的时间，具体范围取决于地区；modern“现代的”只是宽泛时间描述，不能准确替代这一地层年代名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Related expressions: Recent is a traditional name for the Holocene; postglacial emphasizes time after glacial retreat and can vary by region; modern is a broad time description rather than an exact geological equivalent.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: holo- 全部 + -cene 近代：地质时间中的“全新一世”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Whole + recent: the 'wholly recent' chapter of geological time.

morphology.text: 历史构形：bel（美好，盎格鲁法语） + dam（女士，中古英语） → beldam；原先指祖母，后来用于称老妇人。现代使用时整体记忆。

etymology.text: 源自中古英语 beldam，原义为祖母；其中 bel 来自盎格鲁法语“美好的”，dam 是当时对女士的称呼。原本亲近的称呼后来变成了古旧的老妇称谓。

usage_note: 古旧文学用语，常有不友善的语气；日常礼貌称呼用 older woman。不要把它当作对年长女士的普通敬称。

etymology_story.zh: 该词源于中古英语 beldam，与盎格鲁法语中表示“美好的”的 bel 和表示“女士”的 dame 有关，早期曾用于称呼祖母。这个原带敬意的称呼后来演变为对老妇人的称谓，并常带贬义。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Middle English beldam, combining elements associated with Anglo-French bel, 'fair,' and dame, 'lady'; an early meaning was 'grandmother.' This respectful family term later developed into a name for an old woman, often with a disparaging tone.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中宜视为整体词干 beldam，不宜按现代 bell 或 dam 拆解。历史构形为 bel（美好的）+ dam/dame（女士）；复数为 beldams，异体拼写为 beldame，后者复数为 beldames。没有常用的现代派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, beldam is best treated as a single stem, not as a combination of modern bell or dam. Its historical elements are bel ('fair') and dam/dame ('lady'). The plural is beldams; beldame is a spelling variant, with plural beldames. There are no common modern derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: crone“干瘪的老太婆”突出衰老，常带贬义；hag“丑老太婆、老巫婆”侮辱性更强，也常令人联想到巫术；old woman“老妇人”通常只是中性描述。beldam 本身带明显古旧或文学色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Crone emphasizes old age and often a withered appearance; hag is more strongly insulting and may suggest witchcraft; old woman is usually neutral. Beldam has a distinctly archaic or literary flavor.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“受敬重的祖母”到故事里的“老太婆”：记住称呼的感情色彩发生了变化。
mnemonic_anchor.en: From a respected grandmother to a storybook crone: remember the shift in attitude.

etymology.text: 英语借自法语 aiguille，法语本义是“针”。登山用语把这种针尖般的轮廓移用来称呼细高尖锐的岩峰。

usage_note: 登山与山地景观用语，指尖锐的岩石山峰；不是普通缝衣针。法语山峰专名中的 Aiguille 常大写，普通名词 aiguille 小写。

etymology_story.en: English borrowed French aiguille, meaning 'needle,' ultimately tracing back to Latin acus, 'needle.' In mountaineering and geography, the name was transferred to slender, sharply pointed rock peaks because of their shape.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为不可再作常规拆分的借入词干：aiguille；复数为 aiguilles。没有常用的现代英语派生词；法语中的内部词源结构不宜当作英语中的能产词缀公式。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, aiguille is an unanalyzed borrowed stem; its plural is aiguilles. It has no common modern English derivatives, and its internal French history should not be presented as a productive English affix pattern.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: needle“针峰”同样突出细长尖锐的外形；pinnacle“尖峰、尖岩”范围较广，不一定像针一样细；spire“尖塔状山峰”强调高耸如塔的轮廓。aiguille 是尤其常见于阿尔卑斯山语境的专业称谓。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Needle similarly emphasizes a slender, sharp shape; pinnacle is broader and need not be needle-thin; spire suggests a tall, tapering, tower-like outline. Aiguille is a specialist term particularly associated with Alpine landscapes.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 法语“针”竖在山上，就是针峰。

morphology.text: bot（狂蝇幼虫） + fly（蝇） → botfly（狂蝇）；用幼虫的名称连接成虫的名称。这里 bot 不指机器人。

etymology.text: 英语自身组成的复合词，由 bot 与 fly 连接而成。表示寄生幼虫的 bot 在中古英语中已经存在；记成“那种幼虫长成的蝇”就容易区分机器人 bot。

usage_note: 昆虫学名称；关键特征是幼虫寄生于哺乳动物。不是所有苍蝇都属于 botfly，也不是每种狂蝇都寄生于人。

etymology_story.zh: botfly 是由 bot“寄生蝇的幼虫”和 fly“蝇”组成的英语复合词，用幼虫的名称来称呼成虫。这里的 bot 是较早的动物学词语，来源并不确定，与 robot 缩略而来的 bot 无关。
etymology_story.en: Botfly is an English compound of bot, 'a parasitic fly larva,' and fly, naming the adult insect after its young. This older zoological bot has an uncertain origin and is unrelated to bot as a shortening of robot.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构形：bot（寄生蝇幼虫）+ fly（蝇）→ botfly；复数遵循 fly → flies 的变化，写作 botflies。构词基础 bot 的复数为 bots；bot fly 是分写形式。没有常用的进一步派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: bot ('parasitic fly larva') + fly → botfly. The plural follows fly → flies, giving botflies. The component noun bot has the plural bots; bot fly is an alternative open spelling. There are no common further derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: warble fly“皮蝇”通常指幼虫在宿主皮下形成肿块的一类狂蝇，范围较窄；gadfly“虻、扰畜蝇”是较宽泛的俗称；horsefly“虻”通常指成虫吸血的虻科昆虫，并非狂蝇的准确同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Warble fly usually denotes a narrower group of botflies whose larvae cause swellings beneath the skin; gadfly is a broader popular term for flies that trouble livestock; horsefly generally refers to a biting fly of a different family and is not an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: bot 是寄生幼虫，botfly 就是这种幼虫长成的蝇。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Bot means the parasitic larva; botfly names the fly it becomes.

forms: 可数名词；复数 brachiosaurs。Brachiosaurus 是相关属名，不是 brachiosaur 的普通复数。
family: Brachiosaurus 腕龙属，目录词族中列有此形式；学名属名首字母大写。

morphology.text: brachio-（臂） + -saur（蜥蜴；恐龙名构形成分） → brachiosaur（腕龙）；名字让人联想到它比后腿更长的前肢。

etymology.text: 英语名称来自新拉丁语属名 Brachiosaurus，构形成分可追溯到希腊语中“臂”和“蜥蜴”的词。长前肢像有力的双臂，是名字的记忆线索。

usage_note: 普通动物名称 brachiosaur 小写；属名 Brachiosaurus 大写。本词指长颈、前肢较长的蜥脚类恐龙，不是所有大型恐龙的统称。

etymology_story.zh: brachiosaur 来自新拉丁语属名 Brachiosaurus，其构形成分源于希腊语 brakhiōn“臂”和 sauros“蜥蜴”。这个“臂蜥蜴”的名称指向它格外修长、通常长于后肢的前肢。
etymology_story.en: Brachiosaur comes from the New Latin genus name Brachiosaurus, formed from Greek brakhiōn, 'arm,' and sauros, 'lizard.' The name 'arm lizard' refers to its unusually long forelimbs, which were longer than its hindlimbs.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构形：brachio-（臂）+ -saur（蜥蜴；恐龙名称构形成分）→ brachiosaur；复数为 brachiosaurs。相关词族包括属名 Brachiosaurus、brachiosaurid（腕龙科恐龙；腕龙科的）和 brachiosaurian（腕龙类的；腕龙类恐龙）；这些形式并非都由普通名词 brachiosaur 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: brachio- ('arm') + -saur ('lizard,' used in dinosaur names) → brachiosaur; plural brachiosaurs. The related family includes the genus name Brachiosaurus, brachiosaurid ('a member of the brachiosaur family' or 'relating to that family'), and brachiosaurian ('relating to brachiosaurs' or 'a brachiosaur'). These are related formations rather than all being direct derivatives of the common noun.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Brachiosaurus“腕龙属”是正式属名，范围较具体；brachiosaurid“腕龙科恐龙”按科级分类指称相关成员；sauropod“蜥脚类恐龙”范围更广，还包括梁龙等其他类群。因此，后两者与 brachiosaur 并非在所有语境中都可互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Brachiosaurus is the formal name of a particular genus; brachiosaurid identifies a member of the wider brachiosaur family; sauropod is broader still and includes groups such as diplodocids. These terms therefore differ in taxonomic scope and are not always interchangeable.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: brachio- 臂 + -saur 蜥蜴：前“臂”特别长的恐龙。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Arm + lizard: remember the dinosaur with especially long front 'arms.'

morphology.text: flav-（黄，来自拉丁语） + -in（化学物质名称后缀） → flavin（黄素）；把颜色线索与化学名称连起来记。

etymology.text: 国际科学词汇，以拉丁语 flavus“黄色”为基础组成，进入英语成为黄素类物质的名称。它的黄色正是名字留下的线索。

usage_note: 生物化学用语，指一类黄色水溶性含氮色素；riboflavin 是其中常见的一种，不能把所有 flavin 都当作同一种维生素。

senses.meaning_zh: 黄素；一类具有异咯嗪环系的黄色含氮有机化合物，其中一些参与生物氧化还原反应
senses.meaning_en: A yellow nitrogen-containing organic compound with an isoalloxazine ring system, often involved in biological oxidation and reduction.
senses.english_definition: A flavin is one of a group of yellow organic compounds, some of which help enzymes transfer electrons during chemical reactions.

etymology_story.zh: flavin 是以拉丁语 flavus“黄色”为基础，加上化学物质名称中使用的后缀 -in 构成的科学术语。名称最初突出黄色特征，后来用于指以异咯嗪环系为共同结构基础的一类化合物。
etymology_story.en: Flavin is a scientific formation based on Latin flavus, meaning “yellow,” with the substance-forming suffix -in. The name highlights the yellow color and came to designate a family of compounds sharing an isoalloxazine ring system.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词：flav-（黄色）+ -in（物质名称后缀）；它属于科学构词，不能把 -in 当作具有固定化学意义的通用后缀。主要词族和相关复合词：flavins（黄素，复数）、riboflavin（核黄素，即维生素 B2）、flavoprotein（黄素蛋白）；常见术语还有 flavin mononucleotide（黄素单核苷酸，FMN）和 flavin adenine dinucleotide（黄素腺嘌呤二核苷酸，FAD）。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: flav- (“yellow”) + -in, a suffix used in substance names; -in does not specify one fixed chemical property. Principal family members and compounds include flavins, riboflavin (vitamin B2), and flavoprotein (a protein containing a flavin component). Important related terms are flavin mononucleotide (FMN) and flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD).

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: flavin pigment（黄素色素）强调颜色，是接近的描述性表达；riboflavin（核黄素）是黄素类中的一种，不能替代整个类别；flavin cofactor（黄素辅因子）强调某种黄素在酶反应中的功能。三者并非可以任意互换的严格同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Flavin pigment is a close descriptive expression emphasizing color; riboflavin names one particular member of the family; flavin cofactor emphasizes a flavin's functional role in an enzyme reaction. These expressions are related but are not freely interchangeable.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: flav-＝黄：先想到黄色，再想到参与电子转移的黄素。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Flav- means “yellow”: picture a yellow flavin helping an enzyme pass electrons.

pronunciation.note: 美式读音。依据 Merriam-Webster 重拼标音转写 IPA。

forms: 可数名词；复数 allotropes。
family: allotropic 同素异形的；allotropy 同素异形现象。

morphology.text: allo-（不同的） + -trope（具有某种状态的物体） → allotrope（同一元素的不同结构形态）；例如碳可以呈现钻石或石墨的形态。

etymology.text: 英语依照 allotropy 构成 allotrope，使用了希腊语来源的 allo-“其他、不同”和 -trope“转向、形态”这组科学构词成分。想成“同一种元素换了个结构模样”便容易记住。

usage_note: 化学用语，强调同一元素的不同结构形式，例如石墨和金刚石。同位素的区别涉及中子数，不是这里的结构形态区别。

senses.meaning_zh: 同素异形体；同一元素因原子排列或结合方式不同而形成的不同单质形态之一
senses.meaning_en: One of two or more structural forms of the same chemical element.
senses.english_definition: An allotrope is one of the different forms in which a chemical element exists because its atoms are arranged or bonded differently.

etymology_story.zh: allotrope 是在 allotropy“同素异形现象”的基础上形成的名词；相关术语源于十九世纪化学中对同一元素不同形态的研究。其希腊语成分是 allos“其他、不同”和 tropos“转向、方式”，体现“同一元素以不同方式存在”的概念。
etymology_story.en: Allotrope was formed from allotropy, a term associated with nineteenth-century investigations of the different forms of an element. Its Greek components are allos, “other” or “different,” and tropos, “turn” or “manner,” expressing the idea of an element existing in different forms.

morphology_enriched.zh: 科学构词可分析为 allo-（其他、不同）+ -trope（源于“转向、方式”的结合成分）；-trope 本身不等于“物体”。主要词族：allotropes（同素异形体，复数）、allotropy（同素异形现象或性质）、allotropic（同素异形的）、allotropically（以同素异形方式）、allotropism（同素异形现象，较少用）。
morphology_enriched.en: The scientific formation can be analyzed as allo- (“other, different”) + -trope, a combining element derived from “turn” or “manner”; -trope does not itself mean “object.” The principal family includes allotropes, allotropy, allotropic, allotropically, and the less common allotropism.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: allotropic form（同素异形形式）与 allotrope 基本同义；structural form of an element（元素的结构形态）是解释性近义表达；polymorph（多晶型）侧重晶体结构差异，也适用于化合物，因此与 allotrope 仅部分重合。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Allotropic form is essentially equivalent to allotrope; structural form of an element is an explanatory paraphrase. Polymorph focuses on differences in crystal structure and also applies to compounds, so its meaning only partly overlaps with allotrope.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: allo-＝不同：元素身份相同，原子结构换样；想想金刚石和石墨。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Allo- signals difference: the same element takes a different atomic form, as in diamond and graphite.

morphology.text: 整词作为独立词素记忆。camorra + -ist → camorrist（不法团伙成员，派生时去掉末尾 a）；团伙名称与成员名称可成对记忆。

etymology.text: 英语借自意大利语 camorra；在那不勒斯方言里，这个词早先与赌博及赌徒聚集处有关，后来用于称不法组织。可借“赌徒聚成团伙”的画面记住这条词义演变。

usage_note: 较少见、带贬义的名词。本课教为不法目的联合的团伙这一泛指义，小写 camorra；专指意大利组织 Camorra 时通常大写。

etymology_story.zh: 英语借用意大利语 camorra，主要用来称那不勒斯地区的犯罪组织，随后也引申指其他勾结作恶的小集团。这个词的最终来源尚不确定；那不勒斯方言中的早期用法与赌博抽头和敲诈有关，不宜把某一种具体词源解释当作定论。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Italian camorra as the name of the criminal organization associated with Naples, later extending it to other corrupt cliques. Its ultimate origin is uncertain; earlier Neapolitan uses are associated with gambling levies and extortion, so a single proposed deeper derivation should not be treated as settled.

morphology_enriched.zh: 在现代英语中，camorra 通常作为整体借词处理，没有可用于解释其意义的英语前后缀。主要相关形式：Camorra（组织专名）、camorras（泛指小集团时的复数）、Camorrist 或 camorrist（卡莫拉成员）；成员名称可联系 camorr- + -ist 记忆，但不能据此推导原词的历史来源。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, camorra is normally treated as an unanalyzed loanword rather than a combination of English affixes. Related forms include Camorra as the proper name, camorras as the plural in generic uses, and Camorrist or camorrist for a member. The member term can be remembered as camorr- + -ist, without implying that this explains the original word's history.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: criminal syndicate（犯罪集团）是中性的类别名称，不限定地区；Mafia（黑手党）在严格用法中指特定的犯罪组织传统，不能直接当作 Camorra 的正式别名；cabal（阴谋小集团）强调秘密勾结，未必涉及有组织犯罪。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Criminal syndicate is a general category without a regional restriction. Mafia, in precise usage, refers to particular organized-crime traditions and is not an exact alternative name for the Camorra. Cabal emphasizes secret collusion and need not involve organized crime.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 先记那不勒斯的 Camorra，再联想到泛指“勾结作恶的小集团”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor Camorra to Naples, then extend the image to a corrupt clique acting together.

morphology.text: de-（离开、向外） + fenestr-（窗，来自拉丁语 fenestra） + -ate（动词后缀） → defenestrate（扔出窗外）。

etymology.text: 词族的基础是拉丁语 fenestra“窗”，与表示向外、离开的 de- 组合。英语 defenestration 曾用于描述布拉格把人扔出窗外的历史事件；动词 defenestrate 也保留了这扇“窗”的画面。

etymology_story.zh: defenestrate 是从较早出现的名词 defenestration 逆构而来的，词源成分包括拉丁语 de-“离开、向下”和 fenestra“窗”。defenestration 因布拉格历史上的掷人出窗事件而广为人知，动词后来又引申为把人赶下台。
etymology_story.en: Defenestrate was back-formed from the earlier noun defenestration, whose components include Latin de-, “away” or “down,” and fenestra, “window.” Defenestration became associated with the historical incidents in Prague in which people were thrown from windows, and the verb later developed the figurative sense of removing someone from power.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词分析：de-（离开、向下）+ fenestr-（窗）+ -ate（动词后缀）；这是便于理解的结构分析，实际英语形成过程是从 defenestration 逆构。主要词族：defenestrates、defenestrated、defenestrating、defenestration（掷出窗外；罢黜）、defenestrator（实施掷出窗外或罢黜行为的人，较少用）。同源相关词有 fenestration（开窗；窗的布局）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern analysis: de- (“away, down”) + fenestr- (“window”) + -ate (verb-forming suffix); historically, however, the English verb was back-formed from defenestration. The principal family includes defenestrates, defenestrated, defenestrating, defenestration, and the less common defenestrator. Fenestration, meaning the provision or arrangement of windows, shares the same Latin base.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: throw out of a window（扔出窗外）是本义最直接的日常表达；oust（赶下台）强调迫使某人失去职位或权力；depose（罢黜）尤其常用于统治者或高级领导人。后两者只对应引申义。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Throw out of a window is the plain everyday equivalent of the literal sense. Oust emphasizes forcing someone out of a position or out of power; depose is particularly associated with rulers and senior leaders. The latter two match only the figurative sense.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: fenestr-＝窗：先是“扔出窗外”，再是“赶出权力位置”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Fenestr- means “window”: first picture someone thrown out of a window, then a leader thrown out of office.

meaning: 哈姆扎（阿拉伯文字中标示声门塞音的符号）
aliases: 阿拉伯语声门塞音符号

pronunciation.note: 美式读音。依据 Merriam-Webster 重拼标音转写 IPA。

family: hamza 同义异拼；hamzated 带有哈姆扎符号的。

morphology.text: 整词作为独立词素记忆。使用异拼 hamza 可见派生关系：hamza + -ated → hamzated（带哈姆扎符号的，去掉末尾 a 后接后缀）。

etymology.text: 英语借自阿拉伯语 hamza，字面意思是“挤压”。这个名字用于表示声门塞音的书写符号，可把喉部短暂闭合的动作与“挤压”联系起来记忆。

usage_note: 语言学和阿拉伯语书写用语，小写；不要与人名 Hamzah 混淆。在英语转写中，声门塞音常用撇号表示。

etymology_story.zh: hamzah 借自阿拉伯语 hamza，是 hamza 的另一种英语转写形式；其名称与表示“挤压、刺戳”的阿拉伯语词根有关。这个名称用于声门塞音及其书写符号，可联系发音时声门短暂闭合的动作理解。
etymology_story.en: Hamzah is an alternative English transliteration of Arabic hamza, a name associated with an Arabic root expressing pressing or pricking. The term names the glottal stop and its written sign, and can be understood through the brief closure of the glottis during pronunciation.

morphology_enriched.zh: hamzah 是整体借词，末尾 -h 属于转写方式，不是英语后缀。主要相关形式：hamza（另一拼写）、hamzahs 或 hamzas（复数）、hamzated（带哈姆扎符号的，语言学专门用语）；hamzated 可联系 hamza 与 -ate、-ed 的派生形式理解，但不宜简单表述为“去掉 a 再加 -ated”。
morphology_enriched.en: Hamzah is an unanalyzed loanword; its final -h reflects transliteration rather than an English suffix. Related forms include the alternative spelling hamza, the plurals hamzahs and hamzas, and the specialist adjective hamzated, meaning “bearing a hamza.” Hamzated belongs to an -ate/-ed derivative pattern and should not be explained simply as deleting a and adding -ated.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: hamza 是同一个词的不同拼写，意义相同；glottal-stop sign（声门塞音符号）是解释性近义表达，也可泛指其他文字中的相关符号；glottal stop（声门塞音）指语音本身，并非书写符号。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Hamza is an alternative spelling with the same meaning. Glottal-stop sign is a descriptive equivalent but can also refer to signs in other writing systems. Glottal stop names the speech sound itself, rather than its written representation.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 喉口短暂一闭，纸上写个 ء：把声门动作与符号对应起来。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A brief closure in the throat, a small ء on the page: connect the sound-producing action with its sign.

etymology.text: 英语经德语借入，德语科学名称取材于希腊语 phloos“树皮”。韧皮部与树皮内侧的组织相关，因此“树皮”是记住名字的好线索。

etymology_story.zh: 该词经德语植物学术语进入英语，历史基础是希腊语 phloos，意为“树皮”。名称与木本植物韧皮部位于树皮内侧有关。[词源参考](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/phloem)
etymology_story.en: The word entered English through German botanical terminology and ultimately comes from Greek phloos, meaning “bark.” Its name reflects the position of phloem in the inner bark of woody plants. [Etymological reference](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/phloem)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中以完整术语 phloem 为基础，不宜把 -em 当作能自由构词的英语后缀。词族及相关构词包括 phloemic（韧皮部的）、protophloem（原生韧皮部）、metaphloem（后生韧皮部）；通常作不可数名词，比较不同类型时也可见复数 phloems。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, phloem functions as a complete technical base; -em is not a freely productive English suffix. Family members and related formations include phloemic, protophloem, and metaphloem; the noun is normally uncountable, although phloems can distinguish types.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: bast（韧皮组织）多用于树皮中的韧皮组织或其纤维；inner bark（内树皮）是木本植物中的位置性近称；vascular tissue（维管组织）是上位概念，还包括木质部，不能与 phloem 完全互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Bast commonly refers to inner-bark tissue or its fibers; inner bark is a contextual near-equivalent in woody plants; vascular tissue is broader and includes xylem as well as phloem.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture sugar-carrying channels inside bark: the historical meaning “bark” anchors phloem.

senses.english_definition: A flageolet is an organ stop that produces a high, flute-like sound.
senses.collocation_zh: 弗拉佐莱笛音栓；二英尺弗拉佐莱笛音栓
senses.sentence_en: The organist added the flageolet stop to brighten the melody.
senses.sentence_zh: 管风琴师加入了弗拉佐莱笛音栓，使旋律更加明亮。

etymology_story.zh: 乐器义借自法语 flageolet，是古法语 flajol“笛”的指小形式，通常追溯至拉丁语 flare“吹气”；泛音义和管风琴音栓义都与笛声相联系。[音乐义参考](https://dictionnaire.metronimo.com/index.php?a=print&d=1&t=3781) 菜豆义另有来源，经法语追溯至拉丁语 phaseolus“豆”，不能解释为“小笛子变成豆子”。[词源与读音参考](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/flageolet)
etymology_story.en: The instrument name comes from French flageolet, a diminutive of Old French flajol, “flute,” usually traced to Latin flare, “to blow”; the harmonic and organ-stop senses refer to flute-like sounds. [Musical reference](https://dictionnaire.metronimo.com/index.php?a=print&d=1&t=3781) The bean name has a separate history through French and ultimately Latin phaseolus, “bean.” [Etymology and pronunciation reference](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/flageolet)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语将 flageolet 作为完整借词使用；历史上的 flajol + -et 属于法语构词。复数为 flageolets；flageolet + -ist → flageoletist（小竖笛演奏者）；常见复合表达包括 flageolet bean（法式小菜豆）、flageolet tone（泛音）和 flageolet stop（高音笛音栓）。没有常用的动词或形容词用法。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats flageolet as a whole borrowed word; historical flajol + -et belongs to French morphology. The plural is flageolets; flageolet + -ist gives flageoletist, a player of the instrument. Established combinations include flageolet bean, flageolet tone, and flageolet stop. There is no common verb or adjective use.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: recorder（竖笛）是相关但不完全相同的哨口笛名称；harmonic（泛音）是弦乐义更通行的术语；haricot bean（菜豆）范围较广，flageolet 特指其中的小粒浅绿色食用类型。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Recorder names a related but distinct fipple flute; harmonic is the more usual term for the string-instrument sense; haricot bean is broader, while flageolet identifies a small, pale-green culinary type.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 音乐义记“小笛声”：小竖笛、笛声般的泛音和音栓；菜豆义单独记作“法国绿小豆”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Use “little flute sound” for the musical senses; remember the separate bean sense as “small green French beans.”

etymology.text: 经波斯语 atir（芳香的）进入英语，往前可追到阿拉伯语 itr（香水）。想象把花香浓缩进一小瓶油。

usage_note: 较少见的香水原料名称，与 attar 同义；本课指花中提取的香精油，普通句中用小写。

etymology_story.zh: ottar 是 attar 的异体拼写，相关词形经波斯语进入英语，最终源自阿拉伯语 ʿiṭr“香水、芳香”。英语中的词义集中于花中提取的芳香油，尤其是玫瑰香精油。[词源参考](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/ottar)
etymology_story.en: Ottar is a spelling variant of attar, whose related forms reached English through Persian and ultimately derive from Arabic ʿiṭr, “perfume” or “fragrance.” In English, the meaning centers on fragrant flower oils, especially rose oil. [Etymological reference](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/ottar)

morphology_enriched.zh: ottar 是不可再作现代英语词根与词缀分析的借词，通常作不可数名词。相关拼写有 attar 和 otto；rose + ottar → rose ottar（玫瑰香精油），属于复合表达。没有常用的直接派生动词、形容词或副词。
morphology_enriched.en: Ottar is a borrowed base with no productive modern English root-and-affix breakdown and is normally uncountable. Related spellings are attar and otto; rose + ottar forms the compound rose ottar. There are no common directly derived verbs, adjectives, or adverbs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: attar 是同词的更常见拼写；essential oil（精油）范围更广，包括非花类植物精油；perfume（香水、香料）可指调配后的芳香产品，不必是天然花香精油。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Attar is the more usual spelling of the same word; essential oil includes oils from many plant parts besides flowers; perfume can be a blended fragrance product rather than a natural flower oil.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: ottar = attar：把一朵花的香气浓缩进一滴油。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Ottar = attar: imagine a flower’s fragrance concentrated into one drop of oil.

senses.meaning_en: A delicate tissue layer or web-like anatomical structure.
senses.english_definition: A tela is a thin layer of body tissue or a structure that resembles a fine web.
senses.collocation_zh: 脉络组织；黏膜下层

etymology_story.zh: 该词经新拉丁语解剖学术语进入英语，承接拉丁语 tela“织物、网”的意思。细薄组织像织物或网一样铺展，因此这个词被用于命名相应的身体组织结构。[词源参考](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/tela)
etymology_story.en: The word entered English through New Latin anatomy, retaining the Latin meaning “woven fabric” or “web.” Its anatomical use compares delicate sheets of tissue with woven material or a fine web. [Etymological reference](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/tela)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 tela 是完整的解剖学借词；拉丁式复数为 telae /ˈtiːliː/。相关形容词 telar（网状组织的、组织膜的）可按词干 tel- + -ar 理解，但使用较少；tela choroidea 和 tela submucosa 是保留拉丁语结构的术语组合。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, tela is a complete anatomical borrowing; its Latin plural is telae /ˈtiːliː/. The uncommon related adjective telar, meaning pertaining to a web or tissue, can be analyzed as tel- + -ar. Tela choroidea and tela submucosa preserve Latin terminology.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: membrane（膜）强调薄层覆盖或分隔结构；tissue（组织）是范围更广的生物学概念；web（网状结构）强调形态相似，单独使用时不一定指解剖组织。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Membrane emphasizes a thin covering or partition; tissue is the broader biological category; web emphasizes the network-like shape and is not necessarily anatomical.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把组织想成一张细织的薄网：拉丁语“网、织物”连接解剖学中的 tela。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture tissue as a finely woven sheet: Latin “web” or “fabric” anchors anatomical tela.

etymology.text: 来自新拉丁语，追到希腊语 apous（无足的）。这个名称用于代表极乐鸟的南天星座。

usage_note: 星座名首字母必须大写：Apus；不加定冠词。另有同形生物学名称，不能把所有 Apus 都译成天燕座。

etymology_story.zh: Apus 来自新拉丁语，最终源于希腊语 apous“无足的”，这个名称也用于雨燕等足部不显眼的鸟类。[词源参考](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/apus) 星座名称所指的是极乐鸟，反映了早期欧洲人因见到去足鸟皮而产生的“极乐鸟没有脚”的误解。[星座历史参考](https://martzobservatory.org/constellations/detail/Aps)
etymology_story.en: Apus comes through New Latin from Greek apous, “footless,” a name also associated with swifts and other birds whose feet are inconspicuous. [Etymological reference](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/apus) The constellation represents a bird of paradise and reflects the early European misconception, encouraged by skins prepared without feet, that these birds were footless. [Constellation history reference](https://martzobservatory.org/constellations/detail/Aps)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语将 Apus 作为完整专名使用；历史分析为希腊语 a-（无）+ pous（足），其屈折词干为 pod-。星座名的拉丁语属格为 Apodis，缩写为 Aps；这些不是普通英语派生词。鸟类属名规范排作斜体 Apus，种名 Apus apus 中第二个词小写；apodal（无足的）是共享希腊语构词基础的相关词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats Apus as a complete proper name; historically it contains Greek a-, “without,” and pous, “foot,” whose inflectional stem is pod-. The constellation’s Latin genitive is Apodis and its abbreviation is Aps; these are not ordinary English derivatives. The bird genus is conventionally italicized as Apus, with a lowercase second element in Apus apus. Apodal shares the Greek word-forming base.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: the Bird of Paradise（极乐鸟）是该星座名称的英语释名，单独使用也可指实际鸟类；Aps 是星座缩写；genus Apus（雨燕属）指鸟类分类单元，与星座是不同指称，不能互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The Bird of Paradise is the English rendering of the constellation’s name but can also denote actual birds; Aps is its astronomical abbreviation; genus Apus denotes the bird taxon and is a separate referent, not an interchangeable constellation name.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: a- 无 + pous 足：由“无足鸟”的旧观念记住极乐鸟星座；雨燕属也沿用这一历史命名线索。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A- “without” + pous “foot”: the old idea of a footless bird anchors the constellation, while the swift genus shares that naming history.

pronunciation.note: 采用词典所示读音；Merriam-Webster 的重拼标音在此转写为国际音标。

forms: 可数名词；复数 arterioles。
family: arteriolar 小动脉的；artery 动脉。

morphology.text: arteri-（动脉）+ -ole（小）→ arteriole（小动脉）。

etymology.text: 经法语 artériole 和新拉丁语 arteriola 进入英语；拉丁语 arteria（动脉）加指小词尾，意思就是“小动脉”。

usage_note: 生物学、医学用词，指通向毛细血管的小动脉分支；不要与小静脉 venule 混淆。

etymology_story.zh: 英语 arteriole 来自法语 artériole，并与新拉丁语 arteriola 相联系，后者是 arteria（动脉）的指小形式。其历史含义就是“小动脉”，后来成为描述微循环血管的解剖学术语。
etymology_story.en: English arteriole comes from French artériole and is connected with New Latin arteriola, a diminutive of arteria, meaning 'artery.' Its literal meaning, 'little artery,' became a precise anatomical term for a vessel in the microcirculation.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代医学构词可分析为 arteri-（动脉）+ -ole（表示小的名词后缀）。词族包括 arterioles（复数）、arteriolar（小动脉的）、arteriolitis（小动脉炎）、arteriolosclerosis（小动脉硬化）和 arteriolopathy（小动脉病）；相关基础词有 artery（动脉）和 arterial（动脉的）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern medical word formation, arteri- means 'artery' and -ole is a diminutive noun suffix. The family includes arterioles, arteriolar, arteriolitis, arteriolosclerosis, and arteriolopathy; related base vocabulary includes artery and arterial.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: small artery（小动脉）是较宽泛的描述性近义表达；resistance vessel（阻力血管）强调调节血流阻力的功能，范围不完全等同；capillary（毛细血管）是相邻概念而非同义词，主要承担物质交换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Small artery is a broader descriptive near-equivalent; resistance vessel emphasizes the control of vascular resistance and is not exactly coextensive; capillary is a neighboring concept, not a synonym, referring to a vessel specialized for exchange.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: arteri- 是动脉，-ole 表示小：动脉树通向毛细血管的细小枝条。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Arteri- means artery and -ole means small: picture a tiny arterial twig leading toward capillaries.

etymology_story.zh: 中古英语 cate 是 acate 的缩略形式；acate 来自盎格鲁法语 acat，原指购买或购得的东西，尤其是买来的食物。词义后来集中于精美食品，通常以复数 cates 出现。
etymology_story.en: Middle English cate was shortened from acate, borrowed from Anglo-French acat, referring to a purchase or something purchased, especially provisions. The meaning later narrowed to choice foods, usually expressed by the plural cates.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代形式为 cate（罕用单数：一道佳肴）+ -s（复数词尾）→ cates。cate 是整体词干，不能拆成 cat + e；本词没有常用的现代形容词、副词或动词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: The modern structure is cate, a rare singular meaning a delicacy, plus the plural ending -s. Cate is an independent stem, not cat plus e; the word has no commonly used modern adjectival, adverbial, or verbal derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: delicacies（珍馐美味）是现代常用表达，常强调珍贵或特别；dainties（精致美食）偏重小巧精美；viands（食物、菜肴）同样带文学色彩，但不一定指精美食品。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Delicacies is the usual modern equivalent and often suggests something special or prized; dainties emphasizes small, appealing treats; viands is also literary but can refer to food generally without implying exceptional quality.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“买来的食物”到“讲究的佳肴”；末尾 -s 表示一桌美食。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Follow the historical shift from purchased provisions to choice dishes; the final -s puts several treats on the table.

senses.pos: n. 名词（历史军事用语）

etymology_story.zh: corbeil 借自法语 corbeille（篮子），经古法语追溯至晚期拉丁语 corbicula，即拉丁语 corbis（篮子）的指小形式。篮子的形状产生了建筑雕饰义，篮子的实际用途则产生了历史上的筑垒土筐义。
etymology_story.en: Corbeil was borrowed from French corbeille, meaning 'basket,' through Old French from Late Latin corbicula, a diminutive of Latin corbis. The basket's shape underlies the architectural sense, while its practical use explains the historical fortification sense.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 corbeil 是不可再作常用词缀分析的借入词干，复数为 corbeils，没有常用派生动词或形容词。corbis + 拉丁语指小后缀形成 corbicula 属于历史构词，不能当作现代英语的 corb- + -eil。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, corbeil is an unanalyzed borrowed stem; its plural is corbeils, and it has no commonly used derived verb or adjective. The formation of Latin corbicula from corbis with a diminutive suffix is historical morphology, not a modern English division into corb- and -eil.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: basket ornament（篮形装饰）是建筑义的描述性近义表达，但不一定包含花果；gabion（土石笼、筑垒筐）接近军事义，现代还广泛用于土木工程；basket（篮子）是上位词，不自带雕饰或防御用途。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Basket ornament is a descriptive near-equivalent for the architectural sense but need not include flowers or fruit; gabion closely matches the military sense and also has modern civil-engineering uses; basket is the broader term and implies neither decoration nor fortification.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“篮子”：刻上花果是雕饰，装进泥土是工事。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep the basket at the center: carved flowers make an ornament; packed earth makes a defense.

etymology_story.zh: corbie 是苏格兰语中 corby 的变体，与中古英语及古法语表示渡鸦、乌鸦的 corbin 等形式有关，最终关联拉丁语 corvus（渡鸦）。它保留了地域性鸟名的含义，也进入了 corbie-step 这一建筑复合词。
etymology_story.en: Corbie is a Scots variant of corby, related to Middle English and Old French forms such as corbin for a raven or crow, ultimately connected with Latin corvus. It survives as a regional bird name and in the architectural compound corbie-step.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 corbie 是整体词干，不能机械分析为 corb + -ie；拼写变体为 corby，复数为 corbies。相关复合词包括 corbie-step 或 corbiestep（山墙边缘的阶梯状构件）以及 corbie-stepped（具有这种阶梯状山墙的）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, corbie is best treated as a whole stem rather than mechanically divided into corb and -ie. Corby is a spelling variant, and corbies is the plural. Related compounds include corbie-step or corbiestep, a step on a stepped gable, and corbie-stepped, describing such a gable.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: raven（渡鸦）通常是最接近的标准英语对应词；crow（乌鸦）在部分方言语境中也可对应，但标准鸟类名称中不等同于 raven；corvid（鸦科鸟）是范围更广的分类名称，并非精确同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Raven is usually the closest standard-English equivalent; crow can also match regional usage, although standard bird names distinguish crows from ravens; corvid is a broader taxonomic term and is not an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 记住苏格兰山墙上的渡鸦：鸟叫 corbie，墙上的阶梯叫 corbie-step。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a raven on a Scottish gable: the bird is a corbie, and a step along the gable is a corbie-step.

senses.meaning_zh: 网络空间；由计算机网络构成的虚拟交流与活动环境
senses.meaning_en: The virtual environment in which communication and activity take place through computer networks.
senses.english_definition: Cyberspace is the online world where people communicate, share information, and carry out activities through computer networks.
senses.collocation_zh: 在网络空间中；浏览或探索网络空间
senses.sentence_en: Information can spread rapidly in cyberspace.
senses.sentence_zh: 信息可以在网络空间中迅速传播。

etymology_story.zh: 科幻作家威廉·吉布森在1982年的短篇小说《全息玫瑰碎片》之外的作品《燃烧的铬》中使用了 cyberspace，并通过1984年的小说《神经漫游者》使其广为人知。这个词由 cyber- 与 space 构成，随后从虚构的数字环境扩展为现实中的网络世界。
etymology_story.en: Science-fiction writer William Gibson used cyberspace in his 1982 short story 'Burning Chrome' and popularized it through his 1984 novel Neuromancer. Formed from cyber- and space, the term expanded from an imagined digital environment to the real networked world.

morphology_enriched.zh: cyber-（与计算机、网络有关的构词成分）+ space（空间）→ cyberspace；cyber- 源于 cybernetics（控制论）。cyberspace 没有常用的直接派生词，通常也不使用复数；共享 cyber- 的相关构词有 cyberattack（网络攻击）、cybercrime（网络犯罪）、cybersecurity（网络安全）和 cybernetic（控制论的），它们不是由 cyberspace 直接派生而来。
morphology_enriched.en: Cyber- meaning 'relating to computers or networks' combines with space to form cyberspace; cyber- originated in cybernetics. Cyberspace has no commonly used direct derivatives and normally has no plural. Related formations sharing cyber- include cyberattack, cybercrime, cybersecurity, and cybernetic; these are not direct derivatives of cyberspace.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: the online world（网络世界）是最自然、最宽泛的近义表达；the internet（互联网）更侧重实际互联网络及其服务；virtual reality（虚拟现实）通常指模拟出来、常具有沉浸感的环境，只与网络空间部分重合。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The online world is the most natural broad near-equivalent; the internet emphasizes the interconnected network and its services; virtual reality usually means a simulated, often immersive environment and only partly overlaps with cyberspace.

senses.english_definition: Dodecahedra are solid shapes that each have twelve flat faces.

etymology_story.zh: 单数 dodecahedron 的构词成分源于希腊语 dōdeka（十二）和 hedra（座位、底面），合起来表示有十二个面的立体。dodecahedra 保留了源于希腊语的 -on → -a 复数变化。[词源与释义](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/dodecahedron)
etymology_story.en: Dodecahedron is built from elements derived from Greek dōdeka, meaning twelve, and hedra, meaning a seat or base, giving the idea of a twelve-faced solid. Dodecahedra preserves the Greek-derived plural change from -on to -a. [Origin and definition](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/dodecahedron)

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：dodeca-（十二）+ -hedron（面体）→ dodecahedron；将末尾 -on 换为 -a → dodecahedra。词族：dodecahedron（十二面体，单数）、dodecahedra / dodecahedrons（两种复数形式）、dodecahedral（十二面体的）；dodecahedrally（以十二面体形式地）是较少见的规则副词派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: dodeca- (twelve) + -hedron (a solid with a specified number of faces) → dodecahedron; replacing final -on with -a gives dodecahedra. Family: dodecahedron (singular noun), dodecahedra / dodecahedrons (alternative plurals), dodecahedral (adjective), and the uncommon regular adverb dodecahedrally.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: twelve-faced solids（十二面立体）是准确的描述性对应语；polyhedra（多面体）是上位词，不限定面数；regular dodecahedra（正十二面体）只指由十二个全等正五边形围成的特殊十二面体。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Twelve-faced solids is an exact descriptive equivalent; polyhedra is the broader category and specifies no particular number of faces; regular dodecahedra identifies the special case bounded by twelve congruent regular pentagons.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: dodeca- 数出十二，-hedra 提示面体复数：多个各有十二个面的立体。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Dodeca- counts twelve; -hedra signals plural solids: several shapes, twelve faces each.

morphology.text: dys-（困难、异常）+ -phasia（语言表达）→ dysphasia（语言功能障碍）。

etymology.text: 英语借自法语 dysphasie，由表示异常的 dys- 与表示语言表达的 -phasie 组成；两个部分都与希腊语词根有关。

usage_note: 医学用词，涉及语言理解或使用能力；不要看成 dysphagia（吞咽困难）。本课不把语言障碍等同于智力问题。

senses.meaning_zh: 语言功能障碍，尤指脑损伤导致的语言表达或理解障碍
senses.meaning_en: impaired ability to use or understand language, especially because of brain damage
senses.english_definition: Dysphasia is a condition in which a person has difficulty using or understanding language, especially because their brain has been damaged.
senses.collocation_zh: 表达性语言障碍；接受性语言障碍
senses.sentence_en: After the stroke, she developed dysphasia and had difficulty finding the words she wanted.
senses.sentence_zh: 中风后，她出现了语言功能障碍，难以找到自己想说的词。

etymology_story.zh: 这是用希腊语源成分构成的医学术语：dys- 表示困难或功能异常，-phasia 与 phasis（言语、表达）有关。词义由这些成分组合而成，指语言能力受损。[释义与构词来源](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/dysphasia)
etymology_story.en: This medical term combines Greek-derived dys-, meaning difficulty or abnormal functioning, with -phasia, associated with phasis, meaning speech or expression. Together these elements name an impairment of language ability. [Definition and formation](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/dysphasia)

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：dys-（困难、异常）+ -phasia（言语或语言功能方面的状态）→ dysphasia。词族：dysphasia（语言功能障碍，通常不可数）、dysphasias（区分类型或病例时使用的复数）、dysphasic（形容词：有语言功能障碍的；名词：有这种障碍的人）；以人为中心的表达 person with dysphasia 也很常用。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: dys- (difficulty or abnormality) + -phasia (a condition involving speech or language) → dysphasia. Family: dysphasia (usually uncountable), dysphasias (a plural used for types or cases), and dysphasic (adjective, or a noun for an affected person); person with dysphasia is also a common person-first expression.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: aphasia（失语症）常与 dysphasia 指同类语言障碍，不能一概硬分为“完全丧失”与“部分受损”；language impairment（语言能力受损）范围更广，不限定病因；dysarthria（构音障碍）主要涉及说话动作的控制，并非同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Aphasia often names the same kind of language disorder and cannot consistently be restricted to complete loss while dysphasia means partial loss; language impairment is broader and does not specify a cause; dysarthria concerns the motor production of speech and is a related term, not a synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: dys-＝运作困难，-phasia＝语言：语言的表达或理解出了困难。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Dys- means difficulty; -phasia points to language: difficulty expressing or understanding words.

etymology_story.zh: eft 源于古英语 efeta，经中古英语 evete、ewte 等形式演变而来；它原本泛指螈类小动物，现代动物学用法尤其强调陆栖阶段。newt 也与这些旧形式同源，其开头的 n 来自 an ewt 被重新切分为 a newt。[词源说明](https://www.etymonline.com/word/eft)
etymology_story.en: Eft descends from Old English efeta through Middle English forms such as evete and ewte; once a broader name for a newt, it now especially identifies the terrestrial stage. Newt developed from the same historical forms when an ewt was redivided as a newt. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/eft)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 eft 是不可再分析的单纯词，没有可识别的前缀或后缀。词形与组合：eft → efts（复数）；red eft（红色陆栖幼螈）是常见组合；eft-like（像幼螈的）是可以临时构成的形容词，不属于常用固定派生词。该词没有规模较大的常用派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, eft is a simple, unanalyzable base with no identifiable prefix or suffix. Forms and combinations: eft → efts (plural); red eft is an established combination; eft-like is a possible descriptive adjective rather than a common established derivative. The word has no extensive everyday derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: juvenile newt（幼螈）是近义描述，但不一定限定陆栖阶段；newt（螈）可指不同生长阶段；salamander（蝾螈类动物）范围更广，不能与 eft 完全互换。[现代用法](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/eft)
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Juvenile newt is a close descriptive equivalent but need not specify the terrestrial stage; newt can refer to different life stages; salamander is broader and is not fully interchangeable with eft. [Modern usage](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/eft)

senses.meaning_zh: 使观念、习惯等深深扎根；使根深蒂固；ingrain 的异体拼写
senses.meaning_en: to establish an idea or habit deeply and firmly; a variant spelling of ingrain
senses.english_definition: If an experience or repeated practice engrains an idea or habit in someone, it makes that idea or habit become a lasting part of how they think or behave.
senses.collocation_en: deeply engrained habits; engrained in the culture
senses.collocation_zh: 根深蒂固的习惯；深植于文化之中
senses.sentence_en: Years of practice had engrained the routine in her memory.
senses.sentence_zh: 多年的练习已使这套动作程序深深印在她的记忆中。

etymology_story.zh: engrain 经中古英语 engreinen 追溯至古法语 engrainer，原与染成猩红色有关；其中 graine 指用于制取红色染料的胭脂蚧，并非最初就指木纹。后来，人们将它与材料的纹理联系起来，词义也由牢固染色发展为把观念或习惯深深植入。[词源与异体拼写](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/engrain)
etymology_story.en: Engrain goes back through Middle English engreinen to Old French engrainer, associated with dyeing scarlet; graine referred to kermes used for red dye rather than originally to wood grain. Association with the grain or texture of material helped the meaning develop from lasting coloration to deeply established ideas or habits. [Etymology and spelling variant](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/engrain)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代助记分析：en-（使进入、使成为）+ grain（纹理、质地）→ engrain（使深入其中）；这是便于理解的现代分析，须与早期染料词源区分。词族与屈折：engrain、engrains、engrained、engraining；对应的常用拼写为 ingrain、ingrains、ingrained、ingraining；engrained / ingrained 可作分词形容词，表示“根深蒂固的”。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern mnemonic analysis: en- (put into or make) + grain (texture) → engrain, suggesting something worked deeply into a material; distinguish this useful analysis from the earlier dye-related history. Family and inflections: engrain, engrains, engrained, engraining; the usual parallel spellings are ingrain, ingrains, ingrained, ingraining. Engrained / ingrained also function as participial adjectives meaning deeply established.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: instil（逐渐灌输）强调循序渐进地培养观念或感受；inculcate（反复教导、灌输）强调通过重复教育使人接受；embed（使深深嵌入）强调牢固存在于某个体系或情境中。engrain 尤其突出习惯或观念已成为难以改变的一部分。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Instil emphasizes gradually introducing an idea or feeling; inculcate emphasizes repeated teaching; embed emphasizes becoming firmly established within a system or setting. Engrain particularly suggests that a habit or belief becomes a lasting, difficult-to-change part of someone or something.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 像颜色染进纤维：习惯一旦“染进去”，就很难消除。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think of color dyed into fibers: a habit becomes so deeply absorbed that it is hard to remove.

pronunciation.note: 采用词典所示读音；Merriam-Webster 的重拼标音在此转写为国际音标。

etymology_story.zh: grison 于十八世纪从法语进入英语，法语原词有“灰色动物”之意，源于 gris（灰色）。这个名称突出动物背部的灰色毛，与其深色面部和腹部形成对照。[词源、读音与释义](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/grison)
etymology_story.en: Grison entered English from French in the eighteenth century, from a word meaning a gray animal and derived from gris, meaning gray. The name highlights the animal's grayish back, which contrasts with its dark face and underside. [Etymology, pronunciation, and definition](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/grison)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 grison 作为完整借词处理，不拆成能自由构词的英语词根和词缀；历史上可联系法语 gris（灰色）+ -on（名词后缀）。词形：grison → grisons（复数）；greater grison（大灰鼬）和 lesser grison（小灰鼬）是两个物种的常用名称，没有常用的独立动词或形容词派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats grison as a whole borrowed base rather than as productive English root-plus-affix morphology; historically it can be associated with French gris (gray) + -on (a noun-forming suffix). Forms: grison → grisons (plural); greater grison and lesser grison are established species names. There is no common independent verb or adjective family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 没有常用的精确同义词。mustelid（鼬科动物）是上位词；weasel（鼬）通常指另一类鼬科动物，外形相似但不等同；ferret（雪貂）也是不同动物，不能作为 grison 的替换译名。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no common exact synonym. Mustelid names the broader family; weasel usually identifies other members of that family with a similar appearance; ferret refers to a different animal and cannot replace grison.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 法语 gris＝灰色：记住“灰背、黑腹的小鼬科动物”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: French gris means gray: picture a small mustelid with a gray back and dark underside.

etymology_story.en: Kay is an English spelling of the name of the letter K, whose naming tradition passes through Latin kā back to Greek kappa. Kays is its regular English plural.

morphology_enriched.zh: kay（字母 K 的名称）+ 复数词尾 -s → kays；-s 在此读 /z/。核心形式为 kay、kays；直接写字母时，复数通常写作 Ks。
morphology_enriched.en: Kay, the name of the letter K, + plural -s → kays; the ending is pronounced /z/. The core forms are kay and kays; when the letter itself is used, its plural is usually written Ks.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Ks 和 letter Ks 均可表达同一意思：Ks 直接使用字母符号，letter Ks 明确强调所说的是字母；kays 则完整拼出字母名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Ks and letter Ks express the same meaning: Ks uses the letter symbol directly, while letter Ks explicitly identifies the symbols as letters. Kays spells out the letter name.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 一个 K 叫 kay，多个 K 就是 kays。
mnemonic_anchor.en: One K is a kay; several are kays.

etymology_story.zh: laigh 承自苏格兰语及北部中古英语表示“低”的历史形式，与标准英语 low 同源，通常追溯至古诺斯语 lágr。它保留在苏格兰语中，用来描述高度、位置及低洼地。
etymology_story.en: Laigh continues historical Scots and northern Middle English forms meaning low and shares its ancestry with standard English low, usually traced to Old Norse lágr. It survives in Scots for low height, low position, and low-lying places.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代苏格兰语中，laigh 是不可进一步拆分的词基，可直接作形容词、副词和名词。词族包括比较级 laigher、最高级 laighest、状态名词 laighness，以及名词复数 laighs；标准英语 low 是同源词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern Scots, laigh is an indivisible base used as an adjective, adverb, and noun. Its family includes comparative laigher, superlative laighest, the state noun laighness, and plural noun laighs; standard English low is a cognate.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: low 是最直接的标准英语对应词；low-lying 专指土地位置低；低地名词 hollow 强调凹陷地形，而 laigh 只需表示位置较低。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Low is the closest standard English equivalent; low-lying specifically describes land at a low elevation. As a related landform noun, hollow suggests a depression, whereas laigh can simply denote a lower place.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 laigh 连到同源词 low：屋顶低、东西低垂、土地低洼，都是“低”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect laigh with its cognate low: a low roof, something hanging low, or low ground.

etymology_story.zh: Methuselah 来自希伯来语人名 Məṯūšelaḥ，该名字的确切字面含义尚有争议；《创世记》记述的非凡寿命使其成为极其年老者的代称。后来，这个名字也被用于六升酒瓶，属于以《圣经》人物命名大酒瓶的传统。
etymology_story.en: Methuselah comes from the Hebrew personal name Məṯūšelaḥ, whose exact literal meaning is disputed; the extraordinary lifespan described in Genesis made it a name for an exceptionally old person. It was later applied to a six-litre wine bottle within the tradition of naming large bottles after biblical figures.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中整体借入，不能可靠地拆为英语词根和词缀；由人名转为普通名词，属于专名普通化。可数普通名词的复数为 Methuselahs；酒瓶义也常小写为 methuselah，复数 methuselahs。
morphology_enriched.en: The word is borrowed as a whole and has no reliable English root-and-affix breakdown; its common-noun uses result from a personal name becoming a general term. The count-noun plural is Methuselahs; the bottle sense is also commonly lowercased as methuselah, plural methuselahs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: old-timer 指年长者或资历深的人，并不一定极其长寿；ancient 用作名词时可戏称非常年老的人；imperial 在某些葡萄酒命名体系中同指六升酒瓶，但具体名称依酒种传统而异。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: An old-timer is an older or long-established person without necessarily being extraordinarily old; ancient can humorously describe a very old person. Imperial also names a six-litre bottle in some wine conventions, but the preferred term depends on the wine tradition.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 先记《圣经》中的老寿星，再把同名六升酒瓶单独挂到这个名字上。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with the biblical man of extraordinary age, then attach the six-litre bottle bearing his name.

senses.meaning_zh: 潘帕斯冷风；南美潘帕斯地区的强劲冷风，通常来自南面或西南面
senses.meaning_en: a strong, cold wind over the South American pampas, usually from the south or southwest
senses.english_definition: A pampero is a strong, cold wind that blows across the pampas of South America, usually from the south or southwest.
senses.collocation_en: a strong pampero; a cold pampero
senses.collocation_zh: 强劲的潘帕斯冷风；寒冷的潘帕斯风
senses.sentence_en: A pampero swept across the plains, bringing a sharp drop in temperature.
senses.sentence_zh: 一股潘帕斯冷风横扫平原，使气温骤降。

etymology_story.zh: pampero 借自南美西班牙语，由 pampa“草原”和表示关联的后缀 -ero 构成；pampa 本身源于克丘亚语中表示平原的词。这个表示“与潘帕斯有关”的词后来成为该地区典型冷风的名称。
etymology_story.en: Pampero was borrowed from South American Spanish, where it combines pampa, meaning plain or grassland, with the relational suffix -ero; pampa itself comes from Quechua. The word meaning associated with the pampas became the name of the region's characteristic cold wind.

morphology_enriched.zh: 英语中 pampero 是整体借入的名词，复数为 pamperos。其西班牙语内部结构为 pamp-（pampa 去掉词尾 -a）+ -ero；相关借词有 pampa、pampas，但它们不是 pampero 在英语中加词缀形成的派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In English, pampero is a borrowed noun with the plural pamperos. Its internal Spanish structure is pamp-, from pampa without final -a, + -ero; related borrowings include pampa and pampas, which are not English derivatives formed from pampero.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: cold wind 是不限定地区的泛称；southerly 指来自南方的风，并不必然寒冷；squall 强调风速突然增强且持续较短，不能完整替代 pampero 这一地区性风名。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Cold wind is a general description without a regional restriction; southerly specifies a wind from the south without necessarily implying cold. Squall emphasizes a sudden, relatively brief increase in wind speed and is not an exact substitute for this regional wind name.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: pampa 是草原：pampero 就是扫过潘帕斯草原的冷风。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Pampa means plain: picture a pampero sweeping cold air across the pampas.

etymology.text: pein 是英语 peen 的另一拼写；词典把 peen 的来源与斯堪的纳维亚语联系起来，例如挪威语 penn（锤端）。想象锤面背后的小圆头。

usage_note: 指锤头与主锤面相对的端部，可呈球形或楔形；不是锤子的手柄。常见 ball-pein hammer。

senses.collocation_en: a ball-pein hammer; a cross-pein hammer
senses.collocation_zh: 球头锤；横楔头锤

senses.sentence_zh: 用圆形锤头端部把铆钉头敲打成形。

senses.meaning_zh: 锤击金属使其变形、压实或产生表面强化；peen 的另一拼写
senses.meaning_en: to shape, compress, or strengthen a metal surface by hammering; a variant of peen
senses.english_definition: If you pein metal, you strike it repeatedly to change its shape or the properties of its surface.
senses.collocation_en: pein a rivet; pein over the end
senses.collocation_zh: 锤铆铆钉；锤平或锤展端部

senses.sentence_zh: 她锤展铆钉的端部，把接头固定牢固。

etymology_story.zh: pein 是 peen 的另一拼写，后者的来源并不完全确定，通常被联系到挪威语等斯堪的纳维亚语言中表示锤端的词。名词表示锤子的特定端部，动词则由此发展为用锤击处理金属。
etymology_story.en: Pein is a spelling variant of peen, whose origin is not completely certain but is often connected with Scandinavian words, including Norwegian terms for a hammer end. The noun names that part of the tool, and the verb developed to mean working metal by repeated blows.

morphology_enriched.zh: pein 是现代英语中的简单词基，可由名词直接转作动词。词族形式包括 peins、peined、peining；对应的另一套拼写为 peen、peens、peened、peening，常见复合词有 ball-pein、cross-pein 和 straight-pein。
morphology_enriched.en: Pein is a simple modern English base, with a verb formed directly from the noun. Its forms include peins, peined, and peining; the parallel spellings are peen, peens, peened, and peening, with compounds including ball-pein, cross-pein, and straight-pein.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: peen 是同一词的另一拼写，意义相同；hammer 作动词泛指锤击，不限定目的；rivet 指用铆钉连接或紧固，而 pein 强调锤击加工过程，应用范围更广。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Peen is an equivalent spelling with the same meanings; hammer is a broader verb for striking with a hammer without specifying the purpose. Rivet means fastening with rivets, while pein emphasizes the metalworking action and has wider applications.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从锤子的 pein 端，联想到用它 pein 金属：工具部位变成加工动作。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Move from the hammer's pein to peining metal: the tool part becomes the working action.

pronunciation.note: 采用词典所示读音；Merriam-Webster 的重拼标音在此转写为国际音标。

etymology.text: 品种名称来自中国北京的旧英文地名 Pekin/Peking。用原产地记住这种白色家鸭的名称。

usage_note: 作为鸭品种名称首字母大写：Pekin。本课指白色家鸭品种，不指菜肴“北京烤鸭”。

senses.meaning_zh: 北京鸭；一种通常具有白色羽毛的家鸭品种
senses.meaning_en: a breed of domestic duck, typically with white feathers
senses.english_definition: A Pekin is a domestic duck of a breed originally developed in China, usually with white feathers and an orange bill.
senses.collocation_zh: 北京鸭；北京鸭雏
senses.sentence_en: The farm raises Pekin ducks for their meat.
senses.sentence_zh: 这家农场饲养北京鸭作为肉鸭。

etymology_story.zh: Pekin 来自北京的旧欧洲语言名称形式，与 Peking 同源。鸭的品种名称沿用了这一地名，反映其中国来源。
etymology_story.en: Pekin comes from an older European form of the name Beijing and is related to the spelling Peking. The duck breed takes its name from this place-name, reflecting its Chinese origin.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，Pekin 是不可再拆分的地名来源词；表示单只鸭时可数，复数为 Pekins。相关组合有 Pekin duck（北京鸭）、Pekin duckling（北京鸭雏）；没有常用的派生动词或副词。Pekin duck 中的 Pekin 作名词定语，不必另立形容词词性。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Pekin is an unanalyzed word derived from a place-name; when it denotes an individual duck, its plural is Pekins. Related combinations include Pekin duck and Pekin duckling; there are no common derived verbs or adverbs. In Pekin duck, Pekin functions as a noun modifier rather than requiring a separate adjective entry.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Pekin duck 是完整品种名称；White Pekin 强调白色羽毛的北京鸭；domestic duck（家鸭）是范围更广的上位词。Peking duck 通常指菜肴“北京烤鸭”，不能直接当作品种名称的同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Pekin duck is the full breed name; White Pekin emphasizes the white-feathered duck; domestic duck is a broader category. Peking duck usually names the prepared dish and should not be treated as an interchangeable breed name.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Pekin 是北京的旧名称形式：把“北京”与“白色家鸭”连起来记。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link Pekin, an older name form for Beijing, with a white domestic duck from China.

usage_note: 主要用于方言或仿古文体，是及物动词；通用英语通常说 praise。

senses.pos: v. 动词（苏格兰及英格兰北部方言）
senses.meaning_zh: 称赞；赞扬
senses.meaning_en: to praise or commend
senses.english_definition: If you roose someone or something, you praise them or speak approvingly of them.

senses.collocation_zh: 高度赞扬某人；称赞某人的工作

senses.meaning_en: praise or an expression of approval
senses.english_definition: Roose is praise that someone gives to a person or thing.

etymology_story.zh: roose 可追溯至中古英语 rosen，通常认为与古诺斯语 hrósa（称赞；夸耀）相承。它在苏格兰及英格兰北部方言中保留了“赞扬”的意义，并有相应的名词用法。
etymology_story.en: Roose goes back to Middle English rosen and is generally traced to Old Norse hrósa, meaning to praise or boast. It survives in Scots and northern English dialects with the meaning of praise, both as a verb and as a noun.

morphology_enriched.zh: roose 是现代英语中不可再拆分的词基，名词与动词同形。动词变化为 rooses、roosed、roosing，其中 roosing 去掉词尾不发音的 e；名词复数为 rooses。rooser 可指“称赞者”，但较少见。
morphology_enriched.en: Roose is an unanalyzed modern base, with identical noun and verb forms. Its verb forms are rooses, roosed, and roosing, with the silent final e dropped before -ing; the noun plural is rooses. The less common derivative rooser means someone who praises.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: praise（称赞）是最通用的对应词；commend（赞许）较正式，常针对表现或行为；extol（盛赞）强调热情而强烈的赞扬。roose 的主要区别在于其苏格兰及英格兰北部地域色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Praise is the general equivalent; commend is more formal and often concerns conduct or performance; extol suggests enthusiastic, emphatic praise. Roose is chiefly distinguished by its Scots and northern English regional character.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 roose 与其历史核心“赞扬、夸耀”相连：说出某人的好处，就是 roose。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor roose to its historical idea of praise or boasting: speaking of someone's merits is to roose them.

etymology_story.zh: Amarna 沿用当地阿拉伯语地名，通常认为与曾居住于该地区的 Beni Amran 部族名称有关。古城本名 Akhetaten，意为“阿顿的地平线”，因此 Amarna 并非古城名称的英文直译。
etymology_story.en: Amarna follows a local Arabic place-name generally associated with the Beni Amran tribe, who inhabited the area. The ancient city was called Akhetaten, meaning 'Horizon of the Aten,' so Amarna is not an English translation of its ancient name.

morphology_enriched.zh: Amarna 在现代英语中是不可再拆分的专名。相关形容词有 Amarnan（Amarna + -n，阿玛纳的）及 Amarnian（将末尾 a 换为 -ian，阿玛纳的）；常见组合包括 Amarna art（阿玛纳艺术）、Amarna period（阿玛纳时期）和 Amarna letters（阿玛纳书信）。这些组合中的 Amarna 属于专名作定语。
morphology_enriched.en: Amarna is an unanalyzed proper name in modern English. Related adjectives include Amarnan, formed with -n, and Amarnian, formed by replacing the final a with -ian. Common combinations include Amarna art, Amarna period, and Amarna letters, in which the proper name functions as a modifier.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Tell el-Amarna 和 el-Amarna 是同一遗址的其他名称；Akhetaten（阿赫塔顿）则是古代城市的原名。前两者主要指现代地点或遗址，后者强调古城本身及其历史身份。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Tell el-Amarna and el-Amarna are alternative names for the site; Akhetaten is the ancient city's original name. The first two chiefly identify the modern location or archaeological site, while Akhetaten emphasizes the historical city.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 现代遗址叫 Amarna，古城叫 Akhetaten：用“一地两名”记住它。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember one place with two names: Amarna for the modern site, Akhetaten for the ancient city.

etymology_story.zh: Anglophobe 由表示“英格兰、英国”的 Anglo- 和表示“恐惧者、厌恶者”的 -phobe 构成，英语形式通常认为可能经法语传入。-phobe 最终与希腊语 phobos（恐惧）有关，但全词通常表示反感或敌意，而非临床意义上的恐惧症。
etymology_story.en: Anglophobe combines Anglo-, referring to England or Britain, with -phobe, meaning someone who fears or dislikes something; the English form is generally considered possibly borrowed through French. The ending ultimately relates to Greek phobos, meaning fear, but the word normally expresses dislike or hostility rather than a clinical phobia.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式为 Anglo-（英格兰、英国）+ -phobe（厌恶者）→ Anglophobe；名词复数为 Anglophobes。核心词族包括 Anglophobia（排英心理）、Anglophobic（排英的）；对应反义词族包括 Anglophile（亲英者；亲英的）、Anglophilia（亲英倾向）和 Anglophilic（亲英的）。
morphology_enriched.en: The structure is Anglo- 'England or Britain' + -phobe 'someone who dislikes or fears' → Anglophobe; the noun plural is Anglophobes. The core family includes Anglophobia and Anglophobic. The contrasting family includes Anglophile, Anglophilia, and Anglophilic.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: anti-British（反英的）强调反对英国，尤其可指政治立场；anti-English（反英格兰的）更具体地针对英格兰或英格兰人；Britain-hater（厌恶英国的人）是直接且带贬义的说法。Anglophobe 可涵盖对英国文化、人民及制度的广泛反感，形容词用法通常不如 Anglophobic 常见。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Anti-British emphasizes opposition to Britain, especially politically; anti-English targets England or English people more specifically; Britain-hater is a blunt, disparaging expression. Anglophobe can cover broader dislike of British culture, people, and institutions, and its adjective use is generally less common than Anglophobic.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Anglo- 指英国，-phobe 指厌恶者：组合起来就是“厌恶英国事物的人”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anglo- points to Britain; -phobe points to aversion: an Anglophobe dislikes British things.

etymology_story.zh: cesta 借自西班牙语 cesta（篮子），可追溯至拉丁语 cista（箱、篮），再上溯至希腊语 kistē（箱、篮）。英语将这一普通的“篮子”名称专门用于回力球运动中的弯篮器具。
etymology_story.en: Cesta was borrowed from Spanish cesta, meaning basket, ultimately from Latin cista and Greek kistē, meaning a box or basket. English specialized this ordinary basket word to name the curved catching and throwing implement used in jai alai.

morphology_enriched.zh: cesta 在现代英语中是不可再拆分的完整借词，复数为 cestas，没有常用的派生动词或形容词。相关表达 cesta punta 是一种运动名称，不是 cesta 加英语后缀构成的派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Cesta is an unanalyzed loanword in modern English, with the plural cestas and no common derived verbs or adjectives. The related expression cesta punta names a form of the sport; it is not an English suffixal derivative of cesta.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: jai alai basket（回力球篮）是清楚的解释性对应表达；wicker scoop（柳条编制的舀状器具）描述其材质与外形，并非严格的专业同义词；basket（篮子）是更宽泛的上位词。cesta 专指套在手上、用于高速接球和掷球的弯篮。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Jai alai basket is a clear explanatory equivalent; wicker scoop describes its material and shape but is not an exact technical synonym; basket is the broader category. Cesta specifically identifies the curved implement worn on the hand for catching and throwing the ball at speed.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从本义“篮子”联想：把篮子拉长、弯曲并套在手上，就是 cesta。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with its original meaning, basket: lengthen it, curve it, and wear it on your hand to picture a cesta.
